Reference - Authors: Jamie N Sutherland; Jennifer A Maynard
Reference - Title: Characterization of a key neutralizing epitope on pertussis toxin recognized by monoclonal antibody 1B7.
Epitope - Reference Name: 1B7 epitope
1st immunogen - Dose Schedule: 3 doses of 17ug, 1 dose of 20ug and final dose of 25ug PT
Immunization - Comments: A mouse was primed three times with 17ug of pertussis toxin (PTd) in IFA every 2 days by i.p. route and then two s.c. injections and one more time with 20ug of PT s.c. 4 days after third injection. Three months later 25ug of PT were given i.v. and three days post-boost splenocytes were fused with SP2/o-Ag-14 myeloma cells. Details of the immunization process were provided in Sato et al. Infect Immun 1984;46:422 [PMID 6094351].
Assay - Comments: The epitope-specific mAb 1B7 was tested by BIAcore SPR analysis for reactivity against the toxin. Weakening or loss of reactivity was determined for PT sequence variants containing alanine substitutions at these residues which supported their role as key residues.

1st immunogen - Name: manganese ABC transporter ATP-binding protein [Streptococcus pneumoniae]
Immunization - Comments: Mice were immunized with a proteoliposome antigen prepared by re-constituting purified, functional F100SPsaBC reconstituted at high density into phospholipid vesicles consisting of a 10:1 mixture of egg PC and the adjuvant lipid A to facilitate immune response. Hybridoma clones producing antibodies recognizing conformational epitopes in F100SPsaBC were selected by an enzyme- linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) on immobilized phospholipid vesicles containing purified F100SPsaBC, allowing positive selection of the antibodies that recognized the native conformation of F100SPsaBC. Additional screening for reduced antibody binding to SDS-denatured F100SPsaBC was used for negative selection against linear epitope-recognizing antibodies.

The F100SPsaBC-Fab complex was crystallized in space group C2221 with a single (F100S)PsaBC-Fab complex per asymmetric unit.

Epitope - Comments: The epitope residues were calculated from [PDB: 7DM1] as the antigen residues at 4Å atomic distance from the antibody.
Immunization - Comments: Patients with active tuberculosis (ATB) disease were recruited. All patients received standard treatment, recovered, and were eventually discharged. Patient sera were screened for anti-Mtb antibody responses prior to initiation of antibiotics using lysates from two pathogenic Mtb strains, H37Rv and CDC1551. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isoloated from patient, P.4, who had the strongest individual response to PstS1 and retained high anti-PstS1 responses over his treatment course. MAbs directed against PstS1 were isolated by sorting single IgG+, PstS1+ B cells and were tested for their effect on experimental models of Mtb infection. Antibodies were cloned in an IgG1 expression vector.
